recommendation: Keep the published commit. The core HealthcareService source now consistently names offeredIn for the generic-versus-schedulable service relationship, while the FHIR-50073 introduction wording and extension-pack schedulable extension already match the applied Jira decision.
issue_request: FHIR-50073 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification. It asked to clarify that HealthcareService can represent a single located service or a category of services at an organization/location, distinguish generic categories such as Radiology from directly schedulable services such as CT Scan, remove/condense confusing examples including Allied Health and CT variants, update the catalog use case to be location/organization-specific, and create a standard boolean schedulable extension for HealthcareService.
initial_application: Core commit f069f1b7000dabc2e6cf6f6e023f59b5c9613ef9 already updated source/healthcareservice/healthcareservice-introduction.xml with the requested scope, examples, CT condensation, Allied Health removal, and catalog wording. Extension Pack commit 0289b1c2ff9b7de7aa41ae927fb0dbb23328f764 added StructureDefinition/healthcareservice-schedulable with HealthcareService context and a boolean value. HealthcareService is active in source/fhir.ini.
additional_context: The linked Published FHIR-22687 change introduced HealthcareService.offeredIn to model the relationship between a specific schedulable service and a generic service. The current offeredIn definition and checked-in diagram tooltip still said the nonexistent availableIn property could refer to a generic service, even though the element path and comment use offeredIn. PA minutes corroborate the FHIR-50073 6-0-0 motion, and Zulip searches found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/healthcareservice/structuredefinition-HealthcareService.xml and the matching source/healthcareservice/healthcareservice.svg tooltip from availableIn to offeredIn. No further core source edit was made for the introduction text or schedulable extension because those parts are already represented in core and the Extension Pack respectively.
source_changes: source/healthcareservice/structuredefinition-HealthcareService.xml: changed the HealthcareService.offeredIn definition from availableIn to offeredIn.
source/healthcareservice/healthcareservice.svg: updated the corresponding diagram tooltip so the checked-in display artifact matches the authoritative StructureDefinition wording.
